item.title: Metro housing starts up, but headwinds remain
item.description: Twin Cities housing starts rose 22% in January as permits climbed, but experts warn multifamily construction still faces financing and labor challenges.

item.title: India energy summit signals shift away from U.S. order
item.description: At India Energy Week in Goa, leaders discuss a multipolar energy order as Trump-era tariffs strain U.S. ties and India courts new partners.

item.title: U.S. companies prioritize phasing out pollutants despite easing regulations
item.description: Phasing out climate-warming refrigerant gases used in ACs and fridges could prevent nearly 0.5°C of warming and buy time to cut emissions.

item.title: U.S. producer prices post biggest gain in five months
item.description: U.S. producer prices jumped more than expected in December as tariffs pushed up service costs, reinforcing expectations the Fed will hold rates steady.

item.title: $34M TIF district approved for Milwaukee County Research Park
item.description: Wauwatosa officials approved a $34 million tax incremental financing district to support multifamily housing and redevelopment in the county research park.

item.title: Study proposes 650-room hotel for historic Milwaukee theater
item.description: A new study says a 650-room hotel near Milwaukee’s Baird Center is key to attracting conventions, with the arena or theater sites ranked best.

item.title: Just Sold: Davey Tree adds new location in Eagan
item.description: Davey Tree Expert Company is expanding in the Twin Cities after buying a $7.5 million commercial property in Eagan, adding jobs and operations.

item.title: Trump taps Kevin Warsh as next Federal Reserve chair
item.description: Trump nominates former Fed governor Kevin Warsh to lead the central bank, sparking debate over Fed independence, rate cuts and Senate approval.

item.title: Q&A: Wyffels steps into president role at BKBM Engineers
item.description: Tina Wyffels has been promoted to president of Minneapolis-based BKBM Engineers, guiding the employee-owned firm’s growth and 2026 workload outlook.

item.title: Metro multifamily sales top $2.8B in 2025; vacancies dip
item.description: Twin Cities multifamily sales topped $2.8 billion in 2025 as vacancy rates fell and rent growth accelerated amid slowing new deliveries.
